_comment: Delta patch for knowledge/graph/agentic_universe_graph.json. Generic node/edge shape — adapt to agentic_universe_schema.json and validate with tools/knowledge_graph.py before applying. Dedupe proj-hermes-agent if earlier patches were applied.

nodes.label: Dynamic tool schema injection
nodes.summary: Inject only the tool schemas needed for the current step instead of flooding context; maintain a catalog + selector; log injected schemas for auditability (Swarms v15 DynamicToolLoader pattern).

nodes.label: Cyclic graph orchestration (LangGraph-style)
nodes.summary: Structure multi-agent workflows as explicit cyclic graphs with human-in-the-loop gates; deterministic branching to prevent loops/drift in compliance-sensitive flows.

nodes.label: Massive parallel sub-agent routing
nodes.summary: Internal task decomposition + failure recovery across hundreds of parallel sub-agents (Kimi K2.6-style); track amplification ratio (system horizon / agent horizon).

nodes.label: Containerized agent worker pools
nodes.summary: Lead agent breaks goals into tasks, dispatches to containerized specialized workers, preserves a global shared memory pool; map to ECC worktree isolation (superset, orca, dmux).

nodes.label: Multi-gateway fleet control plane
nodes.summary: Persistent registry of local/cloud/SSH/remote agents with health checks; durable agent-to-agent messaging (Hermes hermes peer) instead of fire-and-forget.
